name: Base_Cup
notes: AZ pedestal. Step at z 40 (r 92-104) is the greased thrust face; 208 mm bore is the journal. 6x M6 in the foot flange for a mount plate. Nut traps for the flange-plate bolts open on the outside.

name: Az_Retainer_Ring
notes: Wide flange plate (12x M4x20 + nuts in the pedestal wall) trapping the puck lip: uplift + moment, and the visible AZ seam.

name: Az_Ring_Gear
notes: Internal ring gear 80 T module 2; 6x M4x12 from below, nuts slid into the inner face slots.

name: Sensor_Sun_Gear
notes: Fixed sun of the AZ encoder train: D-flat press fit, a drop of CA; the puck retains it axially.

name: SlipRing_Capsule_22mm
notes: 22 mm flanged capsule slip ring (bought).

name: Arm_R_1
notes: Lower yoke arm (R). Foot bolts (4x M4x25) come up from under the yoke plate into side-loaded nuts; tenon + 2x M4x40 to the shoulder.

name: Arm_R_2
notes: Shoulder segment (R): pillow block top, on-axis cap, servo pocket behind the lower cover. All nuts side-loaded (traps on the Y faces, from the bore, from the servo pocket).

name: Arm_L_1
notes: Lower yoke arm (L). Foot bolts (4x M4x25) come up from under the yoke plate into side-loaded nuts; tenon + 2x M4x40 to the shoulder.

name: Arm_L_2
notes: Shoulder segment (L): pillow block top, on-axis cap. All nuts side-loaded (traps on the Y faces, from the bore, from the servo pocket).

name: El_Bearing_Cap_R
notes: Rounded pillow-block cap, 2x M4x20 into nuts trapped in the shoulder; holds the upper bushing half.

name: El_Bushing_R_Lower
notes: Half of the split plain bushing (36/30.5 x 40). Grease.

name: El_Bushing_R_Upper
notes: Half of the split plain bushing (36/30.5 x 40). Grease.

name: El_Bearing_Cap_L
notes: Rounded pillow-block cap, 2x M4x20 into nuts trapped in the shoulder; holds the upper bushing half.

name: El_Bushing_L_Lower
notes: Half of the split plain bushing (36/30.5 x 40). Grease.

name: El_Bushing_L_Upper
notes: Half of the split plain bushing (36/30.5 x 40). Grease.

name: El_Axis_Cap_R
notes: Right axis cap over the stub end; 4x M3x12 into bore-loaded nuts.

name: El_Axis_Cap_L
notes: Left axis cap: AS5600 column (2 mm off the stub magnet), translucent window; 4x M3x12 into bore-loaded nuts.

name: Status_Window
notes: Translucent disc in the left cap.

name: El_Servo_Cover
notes: Round cover over the servo pocket; integral spacer holds the servo. 4x M3x12 into pocket-loaded nuts.

name: El_Servo_placeholder
notes: Your servo (placeholder box) inside the right shoulder.

name: Head_Puck
notes: Rotating deck: 15 mm journal lip + thrust face (grease). Nuts for the deck hardware sit in hex pockets on its underside.

name: SlipRing_Stub_Clamp
notes: Hex split collar keyed into the puck; M3x16 pinch bolt + nut.

name: Az_Servo_Clamp
notes: Saddle pinning the AZ servo; 2x M3x35 through the deck into underside nuts.

name: Az_Drum
notes: Rotating azimuth housing (same diameter as the pedestal) = electronics bay. 4 pillars + ribs carry the yoke; M4x30 from below, M4x16 from above, nuts trapped in the pillars.

name: Logo_Light_Pipe
notes: Curved translucent plate behind the drum stencil (glue), LED behind.

name: Yoke_Plate
notes: Broad yoke base / drum lid: pillars 4x M4x16 from above (nuts in the pillars), arm feet 4x M4x25 each from below (nuts in the arm feet), round access cover 6x M3x25 (nuts under the plate).

name: Yoke_Access_Cover
notes: Round access cover on the yoke plate; 6x M3x25 + nuts under the plate.

name: Az_Servo_placeholder
notes: Your servo (placeholder box).

name: Sensor_Gear_Keeper
notes: Retains the AZ sensor gear on its pin; 2x M3x45 from the deck, nuts in the keeper.

name: Az_Pinion
notes: 20 T module 2; M3x10 axial screw into the servo's own shaft thread.

name: El_Gear
notes: 72 T module 2 bolted to the right hub wall (4x M4x20, nuts inside the hub).

name: El_Pinion
notes: 20 T module 2 on the EL servo shaft; M3x10 axial into the servo's shaft thread.

name: Sensor_Idler
notes: Runs on the M4x45 axle.

name: Sensor_Gear
notes: 1:1 with the sun; carries the AZ AS5600 magnet.

name: Cradle_Hub
notes: Hollow faceted hub, open top with a bolted lid: every flange bolt (stubs, gear, boom, counterweight arm) ends in a nut inside the cavity.

name: Cradle_Lid
notes: Hub lid, 4x M3x20 into nuts trapped in the hub walls. Fit after all flange nuts are in.

name: El_Stub_R
notes: EL stub axle, flange 4x M4x20 through the hub wall into nuts inside; turns in the split bushings.

name: El_Stub_L
notes: EL stub axle, flange 4x M4x20 through the hub wall into nuts inside; turns in the split bushings. Magnet in the end face.

name: Dish_Boom
notes: Square boom to the dish offset; root flange 4x M4x20 into nuts inside the hub; round end flange takes either adapter (4x M5 + nuts).

name: Counterweight_Arm
notes: Square tube with a row of M4 holes for the canister collar; root flange 4x M4x20 into nuts inside the hub.

name: Dish_Adapter_Plate
notes: Adapter A: slotted plate; 4x M5x20 + nuts.

name: Dish_Adapter_PipeStub
notes: Adapter B: 48.3 mm pipe stub.

name: Counterweight_Canister
notes: Translucent canister (~1.3 L); collar 2x M4x55 + nuts; cap 2x M3x10 with nuts inside the rim.

name: Counterweight_Cap
notes: Press cap, engraved PERIGEE; 2x M3x10 + nuts.

name: Dish_Reference_1m
notes: Reference paraboloid, not printed.

name: Feed_Reference
notes: LNB / feed placeholder.
